name: product-marketing-ops
description: Product marketing and go-to-market strategy for B2B SaaS. Use for product launches, positioning and messaging, competitive intelligence, landscape matrices and G2 review complaints, customer advocacy and referral programs, win/loss, category design, analyst briefings, international expansion, founder-led sales and design partners, moving upmarket, post-acquisition marketing and product sunsets, demand-gen campaigns and channel plans, brand vs performance, public-sector marketing, and agent readiness. Also triggers on: positioning, GTM, ICP, what is our real ICP, why we lose deals, what is everyone in my category doing, table stakes in our category, do we have product-market fit, when to hire our first AE, which country should we launch in next, how do we measure brand, FedRAMP, sell to government, should we publish a SKILL.md for our product, is our site agent-ready, we just acquired a company, merge the two marketing databases, plan a campaign, when to kill a campaign, are reps actually using our messaging.
